items.text: Service
Renovations for all types of property: project, interior design and works with one single point of contact.
One renovation, one point of contact.

We coordinate renovations for every type of property. The renovation and the interior design are planned together, so that the layout, materials and lighting are settled before work begins. Then we coordinate the professionals and keep an eye on timelines and budget through to handover.

The project is developed with the architecture and interior design studio we collaborate with, and you always have the same person to turn to. The technical work and the construction itself are the responsibility of the professionals and companies involved in each project.
When to renovate
When a renovation makes sense

items.title: Before selling
items.text: Not every renovation pays off before a sale. We look at whether a specific improvement can help the sale, or whether it is enough to offer the buyer a works quote. [See property sales](service:venta-estrategica).

items.title: When buying
items.text: The renovation costed before you buy, so you know the full price before you decide. [See Personal Shopper](service:personal-shopper).

items.title: For renting
items.text: Getting the home ready before it is put up for rent.

items.title: For investing
items.text: Renovations planned with the numbers in front of you: cost, timeline and expected effect on rent or sale.
The phases
From the first sketch to key handover

items.title: Visit and requirements
items.text: We see the space and understand how you want to live in it.

items.title: Project and interior design
items.text: Layout, materials, lighting and made-to-measure furniture, all in one project.

items.title: Budget
items.text: A detailed quote before we start, so you can decide without surprises.

items.title: Permits and planning consent
items.text: We apply for any works permits the council requires.

items.title: Works
items.text: We coordinate the trades (builders, installers, carpenters) and keep timelines, budget and quality on track.

items.title: Finishes and handover
items.text: We review every detail with you and hand over the finished property.

Who we work with
Projects with Maria Guimerà Arquitectura

For the project, interior design and works supervision we collaborate with an architecture and interior design studio in Barcelona. HousySpace coordinates and is your point of contact; the studio develops the project and the building companies carry it out.
